profile.headline: Software Engineer | PHP & Laravel | Full-Stack Web Applications | API & LMS Integrations
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 9+ years of experience building web applications and connecting business systems. My strongest experience is in PHP/Laravel, full-stack development with React and Next.js, and API integrations. I enjoy modernizing existing applications and building tools that make complex workflows easier for customers and internal teams.

At Checkmark Plagiarism, I rebuilt the web application in Laravel and own integrations with Canvas LMS, Google Classroom, and Agilix using LTI and REST APIs. At PM Packaging, I built customer portals connected to order and warehouse management systems. Earlier, at Luxer One, I independently redesigned a 20,000-line integration component supporting more than 12 property-management integrations and built configuration tools that let non-engineering staff set up integrations without code changes.

I’m interested in PHP/Laravel, full-stack, and integrations engineering roles where I can take ownership of applications, solve operational problems, and work closely with the people using the software.

Highlights of skills:
PHP: +9 years (Laravel, Symfony, Codeignitor, CakePHP)
Javascript​: +9 years (Vanilla Javascript, Jquery, Angular, VueJs, ReactJs)
MySQL: +9 years (Some Firebase and MongoDB)
CSS: +9 years (Bootstrap, TailwindCSS and Vanilla CSS)

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Checkmark Plagiarism, an EdTech startup focused on AI-driven plagiarism detection, I:
Build and maintain the company’s Laravel 12 web application.
Lead integrations with Canvas LMS and Google Classroom.
Support development of a patent-pending ML solution for keystroke analysis & plagiarism detection.
Advise on architecture, APIs, cloud deployment, and compliance.
Align technical execution with product vision and growth roadmap.

projects.title: GlowIndex
projects.description:
GlowIndex is a beauty product discovery tool that analyzes Reddit discussions using local AI to surface real, community-driven sentiment.

Built with Laravel, Next.js, and LLaMA 3 (via Ollama), the app processes ~20,000 Reddit posts per week to detect product mentions, extract sentiment, and generate insights based on real user reviews. Vector embeddings are used to group related products and track emerging trends in community recommendations.

This was my first project leveraging local LLMs and NLP, a blend of full-stack web development and applied AI that prioritizes privacy, efficiency, and real-world usefulness.
